items.name: BBQ Boneless Baby Back Rib Sandwich

articleHtml:
At Shake Shack, one burger name can represent several very different nutrition totals.

A ShackBurger can be ordered with one, two, or three beef patties. You can switch the potato bun for a lettuce wrap or gluten-free bun, add bacon or avocado, choose fries or cheese fries, and finish the meal with frozen custard, a shake, lemonade, or another drink.

Use the Shake Shack Nutrition Calculator above to build the exact order you eat rather than relying on one generic burger calorie number.

Start With the Burger, Then Choose the Patty Count

Shake Shack's current beef burgers use approximately quarter-pound Angus beef patties before cooking.

For the core ShackBurger, current official nutrition is approximately:

ShackBurger

Calories

Protein

Single

500

29g

Double

760

51g

Triple

1,020

74g

The carbohydrates barely change between these standard versions because the additional calories come mainly from extra beef and cheese rather than additional buns.

That is why patty count needs to be one of the first calculator choices .

A Double Burger Is Not Two Complete Single Burgers

A Double ShackBurger contains two patties inside one finished sandwich.

It should not be calculated as:

Single ShackBurger × 2

because that would incorrectly double the bun, tomato, sauce, and other components.

Use Shake Shack's published Double or Triple serving whenever the customer orders that configuration.

ShackBurger and Cheeseburger Are Different Recipes

Shake Shack's current Single ShackBurger contains approximately:

500 calories

29g protein

26g carbohydrates

30g fat

1,250mg sodium .

The current Single Cheeseburger is approximately:

440 calories

29g protein

25g carbohydrates

24g fat

1,200mg sodium .

The ShackBurger includes tomato and ShackSauce as part of its standard recipe.

Do not treat every cheeseburger as a ShackBurger.

Hamburger Removes More Than the Cheese

The current Single Hamburger contains approximately:

370 calories

25g protein

24g carbohydrates

18g fat

850mg sodium .

This gives users a useful progression:

Hamburger → Cheeseburger → ShackBurger

with each recipe adding different components.

These should remain three separate searchable items.

SmokeShack Needs Single, Double, and Triple Options

The SmokeShack adds American cheese, applewood-smoked bacon, chopped cherry peppers, and ShackSauce.

Current official nutrition lists approximately:

Single SmokeShack: 600 calories and 36g protein

Double: 860 calories and 58g protein

Triple: 1,120 calories and 80g protein.

A calculator that contains only the Single cannot answer the common Double SmokeShack search intent.

SmokeShack Sodium Increases Quickly With Patty Count

The same current official data lists approximately:

Single: 1,880mg sodium

Double: 2,910mg

Triple: 3,930mg.

This is a useful example of why Shake Shack comparisons should keep sodium visible next to calories and protein.

The 'Shroom Burger Is Not a Veggie Patty Burger

The current 'Shroom Burger is approximately:

510 calories

18g protein

49g carbohydrates

27g fat

670mg sodium .

It uses a crisp-fried portobello mushroom filled with cheese rather than Shake Shack's separate Veggie Shack patty.

Do not merge:

'Shroom Burger

with:

Veggie Shack .

They are completely different recipes.

Shack Stack Combines Beef and the 'Shroom Burger

The current Shack Stack is approximately:

770 calories

40g protein

50g carbohydrates

45g fat

1,700mg sodium .

It combines a cheeseburger-style beef patty with the cheese-filled mushroom component.

It should therefore remain a complete named recipe rather than being represented as a generic double burger.

Veggie Shack Needs Single and Double Variants

Current official values are approximately:

Veggie Shack Single: 630 calories, 20g protein

Veggie Shack Double: 910 calories, 31g protein.

The Double uses an additional veggie patty, so it deserves its own current record.

Shake Shack Now Has a Good Fit Modification System

Shake Shack launched its Good Fit Menu as a collection of specific modifications to existing products.

Examples include:

Single ShackBurger Lettuce Wrap

Chicken Shack Lettuce Wrap

Gluten-Free Double ShackBurger

Double Veggie Shack Lettuce Wrap

Double SmokeShack Lettuce Wrap

Double Avocado Bacon Burger Lettuce Wrap .

These are particularly useful for a nutrition calculator because Shake Shack publishes their nutrition directly rather than forcing users to estimate a bun substitution.

Lettuce-Wrapped ShackBurger Changes the Nutrition Dramatically

Current official nutrition lists:

Single ShackBurger on potato bun: about 500 calories and 26g carbs.

Single ShackBurger Lettuce Wrap: about 330 calories and 3g carbs.

The lettuce-wrapped version also contains approximately:

23g protein

25g fat

480mg sodium .

That is a meaningful enough difference that lettuce wrap should be a selectable serving format, not simply a note.

Gluten-Free Bun Is Another Separate Format

Current official nutrition lists a gluten-free bun itself at approximately:

160 calories

31g carbohydrates

350mg sodium .

Shake Shack also publishes finished Gluten-Free ShackBurger configurations.

For example:

Single Gluten-Free ShackBurger: approximately 480 calories

Double: approximately 740

Triple: approximately 1,000.

Use the complete official configuration where possible instead of subtracting one bun and adding another manually.

Burger Add-Ons Need Their Own Nutrition

The current official ingredient table includes approximately:

Beef Patty: 190 calories and 19g protein

American Cheese: 70 calories

Avocado: 60 calories

Bacon, 2 slices: 90 calories

Crispy Onions: 110 calories

Cherry Peppers: 10 calories

Pickled Jalapeños: 5 calories.

These component values make Shake Shack particularly suitable for a true customization engine.

ShackSauce Should Not Be Treated as Zero

The current sauce table lists approximately:

ShackSauce: 60 calories

Secret Sauce: 120

Herb Mayonnaise: 90

Ranch: 140

BBQ Sauce: 70

Honey Mustard: 180

Cheese Sauce add-on: 80.

If a named sandwich already includes its standard sauce, do not add that sauce a second time.

But if the customer orders extra sauce, the additional portion should be counted.

Chicken Shack Has a Complete Published Recipe

The current Chicken Shack contains approximately:

550 calories

33g protein

34g carbohydrates

31g fat

1,170mg sodium .

The standard recipe includes the fried chicken breast and its normal sandwich components.

Use this complete published value unless the sandwich is modified.

Chicken Shack Lettuce Wrap Has Its Own Official Value

The current Good Fit Chicken Shack Lettuce Wrap contains approximately:

420 calories

27g protein

11g carbohydrates

30g fat

1,080mg sodium .

This should be searchable separately from the normal Chicken Shack.

Chicken Bites Need Piece Count

Current Shake Shack nutrition publishes:

6-piece Chicken Bites: 350 calories and 18g protein

10-piece Chicken Bites: 580 calories and 31g protein.

The piece count should always appear in the item name.

A generic Chicken Bites = 350 calories row cannot represent both orders.

Dipping Sauce Should Be Added Separately

Chicken Bites are commonly paired with sauces.

If a 6-piece order is 350 calories and the customer uses a full 180-calorie Honey Mustard serving, the finished order is very different from eating the bites without sauce.

Use:

Chicken Bites → piece count → dipping sauce

as the calculation flow.

Fries Are One of the Stronger Existing Records

Current official nutrition lists:

Regular Fries: 470 calories

Cheese Fries: 710 calories

Bacon Cheese Fries: 850 calories.

These should remain separate products rather than treating cheese sauce and bacon as negligible toppings.

Cheese Fries Add More Than 200 Calories

The difference between:

Regular Fries: 470

and:

Cheese Fries: 710

is approximately 240 calories .

That makes fries preparation a major meal decision.

Mac & Cheese Is a Current Side

The latest official nutrition file includes:

Mac & Cheese with Panko Breadcrumbs: approximately 550 calories

18g protein

28g carbohydrates

41g fat

1,150mg sodium .

This should be part of current side coverage rather than leaving the page limited to fries.

Onion Rings Also Appear in the Current Nutrition Data

The latest Shake Shack nutrition file lists:

Beer Battered Onion Rings: approximately 570 calories per regular serving.

Some offerings may vary by location or menu program, so they should carry the appropriate availability status instead of automatically being labeled nationwide core.

Breakfast Is Much Larger Than Two Records

Shake Shack's current nutrition file includes breakfast items such as:

Egg & Cheese

Bacon Egg & Cheese

Sausage Breakfast Sandwich

Wake Up Shack

Egg White Light

along with double-egg versions and bakery items.

Breakfast availability can vary by Shack, so the category should say:

Breakfast, Participating Locations

rather than implying every restaurant serves it.

Current Bacon Egg & Cheese Is About 430 Calories

The latest official nutrition lists:

Bacon Egg & Cheese: approximately 430 calories

23g protein

26g carbohydrates

26g fat

1,010mg sodium .

The current NutritionSolver record is lower, so this item needs refreshing.

Hashbrowns Need Standard vs “With Sauce” Separation

Shake Shack publishes plain Hashbrowns at approximately:

80 calories .

But the latest official nutrition file also includes a much larger:

Hashbrowns with Sauce: approximately 740 calories.

Those are not duplicate records.

They are different configurations and need explicit names.

Shakes Are Not Just Drinks

Shake Shack's shakes use its frozen custard base, so their nutrition is much closer to dessert than to soda.

Current core values include approximately:

Vanilla Shake: 680 calories

Chocolate Shake: 750

Vanilla & Chocolate: 720

Black & White: 770

Strawberry: 690

Cookies & Cream: 850

Coffee: 700.

These should remain in a dedicated Shakes & Frozen Custard category.

Coffee Shake Should Also Show Caffeine

The current official file lists the Coffee Shake at approximately:

700 calories

and about:

211mg caffeine per serving .

That makes caffeine a useful additional field for certain Shake Shack drinks and desserts.

Frozen Custard Is a Major Missing Search Intent

Current ordering menus continue to sell vanilla, chocolate, and mixed frozen custard cups in multiple sizes. Shake Shack is even running a national custard promotion from July 19 through August 19, 2026.

NutritionSolver should therefore include:

Single Vanilla Cup

Double Vanilla Cup

Single Chocolate Cup

Double Chocolate Cup

Vanilla & Chocolate Cup

and appropriate toppings.

The current official values include approximately:

Single Vanilla: 280 calories

Double Vanilla: 450

Single Chocolate: 310

Double Chocolate: 490.

Floats Need Their Own Category Too

Current official nutrition includes:

Root Beer Float: approximately 470 calories

Creamsicle Float: approximately 440 calories.

A float should not be grouped as a normal soft drink because frozen custard is part of the serving.

Lemonade Size Matters

Current official nutrition lists approximately:

Lemonade Small: 160 calories

and a larger serving separately in the same beverage section.

The current Small Fifty-Fifty is approximately:

80 calories , while the Large is approximately 140 calories .

Use both exact beverage and serving size.

Fountain Drinks Need Exact Product Names

The current nutrition file includes separate Small and Large values for:

Coke

Diet Coke

Coke Zero

Sprite

Fanta

Dr Pepper

and additional regional beverages.

Do not create one generic Soda calorie figure.

The difference between regular Coke and Coke Zero is substantial.

West Coast Menu Is the Current National Limited-Time Menu

Shake Shack launched its West Coast-inspired menu nationwide on July 14, 2026 for a limited time.

It currently includes:

West Coast Burger

West Coast Chicken Sandwich

West Coast Loaded Fries

Spicy Fries with Ranch

Spicy Cheese Fries with Ranch .

Because it is current as of August 2026, NutritionSolver should display it prominently under:

Current Limited-Time .

West Coast Burger Needs Single, Double, and Triple Records

Current official nutrition lists approximately:

Single West Coast Burger: 620 calories and 30g protein

Double: 880 calories and 52g protein

Triple: 1,140 calories and 74g protein.

The burger includes American cheese, Secret Sauce, caramelized onions, and honey mustard pickles on the potato bun.

These should not be estimated from a ShackBurger.

West Coast Chicken Is About 570 Calories

The current West Coast Chicken Sandwich contains approximately:

570 calories

34g protein

36g carbohydrates

32g fat

960mg sodium .

It uses avocado, lettuce, tomato, and Sour Cream & Onion Sauce.

That is a different recipe from both the Chicken Shack and Avocado Bacon Chicken.

West Coast Loaded Fries Are a Complete Current Recipe

Current official nutrition lists approximately:

880 calories

13g protein

70g carbohydrates

59g fat

1,610mg sodium .

The standard recipe includes cheese, caramelized onions, and Secret Sauce.

Do not calculate them as ordinary Cheese Fries.

Spicy Fries Need Ranch Included Correctly

The current West Coast menu also includes:

Spicy Fries with Ranch: about 610 calories

Spicy Cheese Fries with Ranch: about 850 calories.

Because Ranch is part of the named product, avoid adding another full ranch serving unless the guest actually orders extra.

Dubai Chocolate Pistachio Shake Is Also Current for Summer 2026

Shake Shack brought the Dubai Chocolate Pistachio Shake back nationwide on June 9, 2026 for a limited time. It uses pistachio frozen custard, toasted kataifi, a crackable dark chocolate shell, pistachios, and additional kataifi.

It should be clearly labeled:

Current Limited-Time / Summer 2026 .

Because it contains real pistachios, current ordering channels also carry a specific tree-nut cross-contact warning around the shake and other frozen-custard products.

Limited-Time Menus Need Expiration Status

Shake Shack rotates themed menus frequently.

Earlier 2026 promotions included:

Korean-Style Menu

Pimento Cheese Menu

Smoky BBQ Menu

and now:

West Coast Menu .

Do not keep every old promotion in the normal current menu forever.

Use:

Core Menu

Current Limited-Time

Regional

Historical Limited-Time

Shake Shack Nutrition Questions

How many calories are in a Shake Shack ShackBurger?+
How many calories are in a SmokeShack?+
How many calories are in Shake Shack fries?+
How many calories are in a Chicken Shack?+
How many calories are in Shake Shack Chicken Bites?+
How many calories are in a Vanilla Shake?+
How many calories are in a Cookies & Cream Shake?+
Can I order a ShackBurger in a lettuce wrap?+
What is on Shake Shack's current limited-time menu?+

Build the Shack Order From the Burger Outward

For burgers, calculate:

Recipe → Single/Double/Triple → Bun/Lettuce Wrap → Add-ons

For chicken:

Sandwich or Bites → Piece Count → Sauce

Then add:

Fries or Side → Extra Sauce → Drink

If you order dessert, choose the exact:

Shake → Frozen Custard → Float

and current flavor.

For limited-time foods, make sure the menu status and nutrition source date match the product currently being sold.

Shake Shack publishes unusually detailed component nutrition, so the best calculator is not a giant list of disconnected foods. It is a builder that connects the base recipe, patty count, serving format, add-ons, sides, sauces, and frozen-custard choices into the actual order.
